|translation='''Title:''' Jawa Nap.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. To deploy, use 3 Force from both players' Force Piles. Otherwise it cannot be deployed. All Jawas have their forfeit increased by 1.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Three Jawas taking a cool nap at midday in Mos Eisley to conserve their energy.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese applies the forfeit bonus to all Jawas.
